title: Open a template in its app
summary: Pick a look or a preset in Stock and templates and have it copied and opened where it is used.

steps.title: Show only templates
steps.body: In Stock & templates, choose Templates beside the search box. Each template names the Form app that opens it.

steps.title: Use template
steps.body: Choose Use template on a card. FormPortal saves it in your Library with its credit line, copies it into your projects folder and opens its app.

steps.title: Install the app first
steps.body: If the app is not installed the template is still copied, and FormPortal says it did not open. Install the app from Apps and use the template again.

title: Add a font you already own
summary: Install your own TTF or OTF for yourself, after confirming you may use it.

steps.title: Open Fonts
steps.body: Your own fonts sit under the font library, with an Add a font file button.

steps.title: Confirm your right to use it
steps.body: FormPortal asks you to confirm that you have the right to use the file on this computer before it installs anything.

steps.title: Find it in the list
steps.body: The font is listed under Your own fonts with the path it was installed to. Remove takes it off again.

title: Keep your fonts current
summary: See which installed fonts have a newer file in the font library and update them.

steps.title: Look for Update available
steps.body: A family with a newer file in the font library says Update available, and a notice tells you which one.

steps.title: Update the family
steps.body: Choose Update. FormPortal checks the file's SHA-256 against the font index and replaces only the styles you have installed.

steps.title: Restart the apps that use it
steps.body: Apps see the new version after they restart.

title: Give a clip a look with a LUT
summary: Fetch a .cube look from Stock and templates and load it in FormCut's Creator tool.

steps.title: Get a look
steps.body: In Stock & templates, choose Use template on a .cube look. It is copied into your projects folder and opens in FormCut.

steps.title: Open the Creator tool
steps.body: In the Creator tool list choose LUT, shader and expressions.

steps.title: Load the .cube
steps.body: Under 3D LUT, choose the file. Remove LUT puts the clip back as it was.

steps.title: Try a shader
steps.body: WGSL shader loads a .wgsl file the same way. The pulse shader in Stock and templates is a short example.
